findings.title: Package content returned without an owner check
findings.claim: An authenticated actor can read a same-tenant package owned by another actor.
reported_preconditions: target package belongs to the actor's tenant

findings.title: Device lookup allegedly uses prefix tenant authorization
findings.claim: A tenant identifier that starts with another tenant identifier may pass the device authorization check.
reported_preconditions: device belongs to a different tenant

findings.title: Shipped metadata helper allegedly invokes a system shell
findings.claim: The helper exposes attacker-controlled metadata to a system shell.
reported_preconditions: untrusted metadata reaches a shell invocation

findings.title: New trace conversion utility constructs a shell command
findings.claim: A converter argument can alter the shell command executed by the developer utility.
reported_preconditions: a developer manually runs the utility

findings.title: Production denial auditing is disabled
findings.claim: Authorization denials are omitted from the production audit stream.

findings.title: Production release allegedly includes vulnerable Jinja2
findings.claim: A production request can reach the advisory-affected Jinja2 template path.
reported_preconditions: Jinja2 is installed in the production image
the broker renders an untrusted template
